synthesis.climate_context: Shared Melbourne-metro temperate climate — rain, mud and grit tracked into high-traffic entrances, foyers and washrooms; general Melbourne context, not a suburb-specific measured claim.
synthesis.building_stock: Inner-eastern established residential suburb; residential development spurred by the 1912 tram extension and accelerated post-World War II along Burwood Highway. Contains newer large housing developments (e.g. former Vision Australia site) and Victorian Heritage Register-listed places. [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Burwood,_Victoria]
synthesis.council_notes: LGA: Split across City of Monash and City of Whitehorse | postcode 3125 | 14 km east

retail_centres: Burwood shopping centre at the intersection of Warrigal Road and Burwood Highway (the suburb's main shopping centre) [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Burwood,_Victoria]
Bennettswood shopping strip, corner of Burwood Highway and Station Street [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Burwood,_Victoria]
Burwood One shopping centre (Kmart/Aldi anchored, Kmart trades 24 hours) — located in adjoining Burwood East at Burwood Highway and Blackburn Road [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Burwood_East]
Burwood Brickworks shopping centre (opened Dec 2019, Woolworths anchor, rooftop farm) — located in adjoining Burwood East [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Burwood_East]
office_or_business_precincts: Greenwood Business Park, 301 Burwood Highway, Burwood 3125 — campus-style office park built 1991, three separate office buildings, approx 20,000 sqm of commercial accommodation [source: https://www.melbourneacquisitions.com.au/greenwood-business-park-301-burwood-highway-burwood/]
Greenwood Business Park hosts serviced/flexible office suites operated by Regus at 301 Burwood Hwy [source: https://www.regus.com/en/au/6186]
The Greenwood business park occupies the former Vision Australia school site on Burwood Highway [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Burwood,_Victoria]

Tally Ho Business Park, corner Burwood Highway and Springvale Road — hosts headquarters of the Country Fire Authority and former regional HQs of VicRoads and Yokogawa; adjacent Vision Drive hosts World Vision Australia's National Office, The GPT Group and the National Archives of Australia Melbourne Repository. Located in adjoining Burwood East [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Burwood_East]
institutions: Deakin University Burwood Campus — the largest built form in the suburb, on Burwood Highway [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Burwood,_Victoria]
Mount Scopus Memorial College, Gandel Campus [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Burwood,_Victoria]
Wattle Park Primary School and St Scholastica's Primary School [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Burwood,_Victoria]
Aged care facilities: Elizabeth Gardens (Elizabeth Street), Highwood House (Warrigal Road), Burwood Hill (Edwards Street) [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Burwood,_Victoria]
Retirement villages: Fountain Court (Station Street) and Cameron Close (Warrigal Road) [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Burwood,_Victoria]
hospitality_strips: Burwood Highway commercial frontage, which carries the suburb's post-war commercial development eastward from Warrigal Road [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Burwood,_Victoria]
commercial_anchors.commercial_summary: Burwood's commercial base is anchored by Deakin University's Burwood Campus and by Greenwood Business Park at 301 Burwood Highway, a three-building, roughly 20,000 sqm office park that includes serviced office suites. Street-level trade is concentrated in the Warrigal Road / Burwood Highway shopping centre and the smaller Bennettswood strip, while the suburb also carries a cluster of independent schools, aged care homes and retirement villages. Larger retail and corporate premises (Burwood One, Burwood Brickworks and the Tally Ho Business Park) sit immediately over the boundary in Burwood East.
